contract.temporary_bitmap_lifetime: Before restoration records exist, during conservative prediction only.

right.source_movement: Actual JOY1 RIGHT, X 81 -> 81.5 through retained input-history, ground/frame, velocity and check_move pipeline

integration_changes: Pin Q7 observer rewriting to its four capacity reads and three capacity comparisons, retaining every write guard.
Copy identical matched Mesen runtime binaries and effective settings into a private portable runtime; change only screenshot/save output paths.
Seed private save data with the original bor.srm input verbatim and retain its SHA256; preserve the original settings and SRAM files.
Guard D676/D677 writes by the two exact post-STA callback PCs, including the final store completion at Q7PolicyDone; keep SA-1 rejection.
Normalize live integer and serialized string transaction keys before comparing all original borrowing-order fields.
Read partial-mode policy tuples as (completed records, mode, capacity); require a nonempty mode-2/capacity-6 policy and no eighth transaction-3 transfer.
excluded_trials: v3-v5 default screenshot folder permission failure
v6 policy-store callback endpoint false fault
v7 private runtime omitted pre-existing SRAM input
v8 first aggregation used string pool keys against live integer keys; first explicit collection used wrong policy-tuple slice

excluded_focused_run.reason: Driver omitted the separate 14-test bitmap-shared block; replaced by the complete 277-test run
